title: We Are Kinsmen
text: Please let there be no contention between you and me … After all, we are kinsmen.

title: Like the Garden of the LORD
text: … the whole plain of the Jordan … was well watered like the garden of the LORD …

title: Lift Up Your Eyes
text: Now lift up your eyes from the place where you are, and look to the north and south and east and west

title: Like the Dust of the Earth
text: I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth …

title: I Am Your Shield
text: Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.

title: Count the Stars
text: Now look to the heavens and count the stars, if you are able. … So shall your offspring be.

title: Abram Believed
text: Abram believed the LORD, and it was credited to him as righteousness.

title: Eliezer of Damascus
text: … the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus …

title: Livestock and Silver and Gold
text: And Abram had become extremely wealthy in livestock and silver and gold.

title: Bread and Wine
text: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine—since he was priest of God Most High—

title: He Calls Them by Name
text: He determines the number of the stars; He calls them each by name.

title: Heirs of the Promise
text: And if you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s seed and heirs according to the promise.
